name: NSF Awards API
test_result: HTTP 200; ~116 filtered records retrieved across 39 keywords; zero failures
limitations: NSF only - misses NIH, DOE, DOD, NOAA, USDA SBIR. Keyword search hits abstracts so precision is ~20-28%; needs downstream classification.

name: USAspending API
test_result: HTTP 200; returned detailed contract records across 7 ocean keyword queries
useful_fields: Award ID;Recipient Name;Award Amount;Awarding Agency;Awarding Sub Agency;Description;Start Date
limitations: Returns procurement and services contracts, not startups. Use to evidence customer budgets and map incumbents, NOT to discover companies.

name: SBIR.gov API
test_result: HTTP 403 Forbidden on all endpoint variants, with and without browser User-Agent; legacy path 404
terms_notes: Blocked server-side; robots.txt reviewed; no bypass attempted
recommendation: Not usable - substitute NSF API + USAspending
limitations: Would have been the ideal cross-agency SBIR source. Its absence makes the Phase 1 lead set NSF-biased and under-represents Navy/NOAA/DOE dual-use recipients.

name: ARPA-E program and project pages
test_result: HTTP 403 Forbidden via both WebFetch and curl with browser User-Agent
terms_notes: Blocked to automated requests; no bypass attempted
limitations: SEA-CO2 program is highly relevant (36M USD, 11 projects, mCDR MRV). Awardee data recoverable via DOE press releases and secondary sources.

name: PatentsView API
test_result: Empty response without API key
limitations: Real gap. Patents are core evidence; ARMADA lead is anchored on two patents sourced from press rather than a patent database. Highest-value query: assignee = university.

name: USPTO Open Data Portal API
test_result: HTTP 401 Unauthorized
limitations: Alternative or complement to PatentsView.

name: OpenAlex API
test_result: HTTP 200; 61,818 works for 'ocean alkalinity enhancement' in 85ms
limitations: Publication volume is NOT commercialization intent. Use to corroborate candidates surfaced by commercialization signals, never as a primary discovery channel.

name: arXiv API
test_result: HTTP 200 with valid Atom - HTTPS required, HTTP endpoint returned nothing
limitations: Near-useless for categories 4, 5, 7 - ocean chemistry, materials and aquaculture publish in journals, not preprints.

name: Grants.gov Search2 API
test_result: HTTP 200; hitCount 43 for keyword 'ocean' with forecasted|posted statuses
limitations: Forecasted opportunities are a 6-18 month leading indicator of where federal money will flow. Thesis input, not company discovery.

name: SEC EDGAR full-text search
test_result: HTTP 200 with descriptive User-Agent; dateRange=custom returns 500, startdt/enddt work
rate_limits: SEC requires descriptive User-Agent with contact
limitations: Indexed Form D content is primary_doc.xml (name, address, SIC, offering amount) with no technology description, so keyword discovery by technology does not work. Use to verify a known candidate's financing.

name: Propeller website, blog and sitemap
test_result: HTTP 200; sitemap.xml enumerated 61 URLs; /team returns 404 and is absent from sitemap
useful_fields: themes;stage;check size;portfolio;process;blog posts with authors and dates
terms_notes: robots.txt disallows only HubSpot preview/preference paths
limitations: The /team page 404s. Two most recent posts (ocean compute 2026-07-28; coastal heat adaptation 2026-08-13) are the clearest current statements of interest.

name: University of Rhode Island news
test_result: HTTP 200; detailed dated items naming companies, founders and licensed technologies
limitations: Highest-yield university news source found. Surfaced Juice Robotics and the ONR RISE-UP expansion.

name: UC San Diego Today / Chancellor's Innovation Awards
test_result: HTTP 200; 2026 Chancellor's Innovation Awards finalists listed with founders and technology
limitations: Surfaced Hybrid Reefs (Scripps).

name: StartBlue Ocean Enterprise Accelerator
test_result: HTTP 200; cohort ventures enumerated by cohort number
limitations: No-cost/no-equity Scripps + Rady accelerator. Named ventures include Hybrid Reefs, Ocean Motion Technologies, Del Mar Oceanographic, AquaPoro, Greenwater Scientific, Kai Pono Solutions, CalWave.

name: WHOI press room
test_result: HTTP 200; license and spinout announcements available
limitations: Surfaced ARMADA Marine Robotics licenses. Propeller's founding partner institution.

name: WHOI Technology Transfer
test_result: HTTP 302 redirect to https://intranet.whoi.edu/inventors which failed to connect (HTTP 000)
limitations: Previously public available-technology listings are no longer reachable. Licensing news must now be caught via whoi.edu press releases and trade press.

name: UW CoMotion (tech transfer)
test_result: Connection failed (HTTP 000) on 2026-08-21
limitations: UW is the origin of Propeller portfolio company Banyu Carbon.

name: Oregon State Technology Entrepreneurship / commercialization
test_result: Connection failed (HTTP 000) on 2026-08-21
limitations: OSU is a Propeller partner; news.oregonstate.edu and pacwaveenergy.org are reachable alternatives.

name: SeaAhead / BlueSwell
test_result: Reachable; cohort and news posts available
limitations: Boston-based, same city as Propeller. Alumnus atdepth MRV won ARPA-E 2.52M USD. 2026 Pilot program theme is Coastal Resilience and Coastal Asset Protection.

name: OCEANS (MTS/IEEE) proceedings
test_result: not tested in Phase 1
terms_notes: IEEE terms; many full texts paywalled
limitations: Primary ocean engineering technical conference. Author affiliations reveal pre-company technical teams. Labour-intensive; not recommended for automation.
